body.en: Read the `busa-linkedin-desk` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then add the company I describe: name, LinkedIn company page, industry, website. If it already exists, show me the existing row instead of creating a duplicate.
body.zh-CN: 先阅读本文件夹的 `busa-linkedin-desk` skill 并遵循其工作流程，然后添加我描述的公司：名称、LinkedIn 公司页、行业、网站。如果已存在，给我看已有记录，不要重复新建。

body.en: Read the `busa-linkedin-desk` skill in this folder, then show me every contact at the company I name and the latest message thread with each of them. Do not change anything.
